title: 新加坡与中国应深化AI与能源合作
titleEn: Singapore and China should deepen AI and energy ties
summary: 国家发展部长徐芳达在新中论坛呼吁两国深化AI应用与能源韧性合作。
summaryEn: National Development Minister Chee Hong Tat, speaking at the Singapore-China Forum, calls for deeper bilateral cooperation on AI adoption and energy resilience.
speaker: Chee Hong Tat
editNote: Hand-corrected: LLM had titled Chee Hong Tat as Senior Minister; the CNA description confirms Minister for National Development at the Singapore-China Forum.
